name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: The Lord of Blackrock is an Alliance quest initiated upon claiming the severed head of the black dragon Nefarian within Blackwing Lair. Delivering this monstrous trophy to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep announces the downfall of the master of Blackrock Mountain. It marks one of the greatest military triumphs the Alliance has celebrated in recent history.

sections.title: A Monument to Victory
sections.body: Nefarian, the insidious brood-master of the Black Dragonflight and ruler of Upper Blackrock Spire, has long cast a terrifying shadow over the surrounding human kingdoms. Slaying him is not merely an act of survival; it represents the utter dismantling of his twisted experiments and scheming. Carrying his colossal, battle-scarred head back to Stormwind serves as undeniable proof that the Lord of Blackrock has met his end at the hands of the Alliance's greatest heroes.

sections.title: Audience at Stormwind Keep
sections.body: The grisly prize is brought directly to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, who governs the kingdom from the throne room of Stormwind Keep. The sudden arrival of a dragon's severed head inside the royal court shocks onlookers and commands immediate reverence. For a kingdom already straining under internal political strife and external threats, this victory provides the realm with a momentous morale surge and an unforgettable entry into the annals of Alliance history.

faq.q: What is the Lord of Blackrock quest about?
faq.answer: This quest begins when adventurers claim the severed Head of Nefarian in Blackwing Lair. It directs the victor to carry the monumental trophy back to Stormwind City and present it to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon on behalf of the kingdom.

Nefarian is a great black dragon and the son of Deathwing. Ruling from the heights of Blackwing Lair inside Blackrock Mountain, he commanded the Blackrock orcs and conducted sinister experiments to create the chromatic dragonflight.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is the paladin who rules Stormwind as regent in King Varian Wrynn's absence, holding court in the throne room of Stormwind Keep and watching over the young Prince Anduin Wrynn.

faq.q: Why is this trophy brought to Stormwind Keep?
faq.answer: Nefarian's dominion in Blackrock Mountain posed a mortal threat to the kingdom of Stormwind and the entire southern continent. Bringing the trophy directly to the kingdom's military leadership confirms the dragon's destruction and allows the realm to rally around the heroic feat.

faq.q: What happens after giving the head to Bolvar?
faq.answer: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is astounded by the feat, declaring that the triumph will be permanently recorded in history. This directly leads into the subsequent stage of the event, where the head is mounted publicly for all of Stormwind to see.

faq.q: Does turning in this head affect the whole city?
faq.answer: Yes. When the head of Nefarian is delivered to the capital and hoisted above the city gates, it signals the dragon's demise to all citizens and soldiers present, filling the defenders of Stormwind with triumphant resolve.

angles.text: Presenting the head of the black dragon Nefarian is one of the crowning martial achievements for the Alliance, decisively crushing the dragonflight's schemes against human territories.
Stormwind has suffered countless incursions and plots orchestrated from Blackrock Mountain; seeing its master defeated provides the realm with long-sought retribution and relief.
